cases.prompt: Add an automated accessibility check to this Playwright test so it fails on serious WCAG violations.
expectations: Uses @axe-core/playwright (AxeBuilder) or an equivalent axe-core integration inside the existing test.
Limits the scan to WCAG tags (such as wcag2a, wcag2aa) or filters by impact so that serious or critical violations fail the test.
Asserts that the resulting violations list is empty (or empty after filtering).
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.

cases.prompt: Our Cypress suite needs an accessibility check on the /checkout page. Show me how to add it.
expectations: Installs and imports cypress-axe (or axe-core) in the support file.
Calls injectAxe after cy.visit and before checkA11y.
Shows how to scope or configure the check (a context selector, rules, or includedImpacts).
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.
